about.title: About Built Right Construction
about.text: Established in 1996, Built Right Construction is locally owned and operated by Mark Crawford, a licensed remodeling contractor and Certified EPA Lead-Safe Renovator with more than 20 years of experience in building, design, and construction. We are fully licensed, bonded, and insured, with references and proof of insurance and license available on request, so you can be assured your project will be built right the first time. We offer free estimates with no obligation.

services.title: Home Additions
services.shortDescription: Room additions, second-story additions, garages, and outbuildings.
services.longDescription: Need more space but don't want to move? We design and build room additions and extensions, second-story additions, attached garages, free-standing outbuildings, and carport conversions.

faq.q: Why choose us for Home Additions?
faq.a: We provide guaranteed workmanship, premium materials, and experienced professional technicians.

faq.q: Will an addition require a permit?
faq.a: Yes, most home additions require permits, which we handle as part of the project.

faq.q: Can you match the addition to my home's existing style?
faq.a: Yes, we design additions to blend seamlessly with your home's existing rooflines, siding, and finishes.

faq.q: Do you build second-story additions?
faq.a: Yes, we handle second-story additions in addition to single-level room extensions.

faq.q: How much space can an addition add to my home?
faq.a: It depends on your lot and layout. We'll walk your property and discuss realistic options during your free estimate.

services.title: Kitchen Remodeling
services.shortDescription: Full kitchen remodels, reconfigured layouts, and custom backsplash work.
services.longDescription: We re-configure kitchens and utilities, removing or pushing out walls to create more space, and finish with custom tile, cabinetry, and lighting built to last.

faq.q: Why choose us for Kitchen Remodeling?
faq.a: We provide guaranteed workmanship, premium materials, and experienced professional technicians.

faq.q: Can you move plumbing and electrical during a kitchen remodel?
faq.a: Yes, we can reconfigure plumbing and electrical as needed to support your new layout.

faq.q: Do you help with cabinet and material selection?
faq.a: Yes, we can guide you through cabinetry, countertop, and finish options that fit your budget.

faq.q: Can you open up my kitchen to an adjoining room?
faq.a: In many cases, yes. We can remove or reconfigure walls where structurally possible.

faq.q: How long will I be without a working kitchen?
faq.a: Timelines vary by project scope. We'll walk you through an estimated schedule before work begins.

services.title: Bathroom Remodeling
services.shortDescription: Bathroom additions and remodels with custom tile and fixtures.
services.longDescription: From full bathroom additions to complete remodels, we handle plumbing, tile, and finish work to create a master bath or guest bath that fits your home and budget.

faq.q: Why choose us for Bathroom Remodeling?
faq.a: We provide guaranteed workmanship, premium materials, and experienced professional technicians.

faq.q: Can you add a bathroom where there wasn't one before?
faq.a: Yes, we handle full bathroom additions, including new plumbing and electrical.

faq.q: Do you install walk-in and curbless showers?
faq.a: Yes, we install a range of shower styles, including walk-in and curbless designs.

faq.q: Can you update just the tile and fixtures without a full remodel?
faq.a: Yes, we can scope a project to fit your goals, from a full remodel to targeted updates.

faq.q: Are your bathroom remodels water-damage resistant?
faq.a: We use proper waterproofing and moisture-resistant materials behind tile and fixtures.

services.title: Decks & Patios
services.shortDescription: Deck building and repair, covered patios, and outdoor kitchens.
services.longDescription: We design and build custom decks and covered patios, including second-story deck replacements, deck repair, and outdoor fireplace and kitchen installations.

faq.q: Why choose us for Decks & Patios?
faq.a: We provide guaranteed workmanship, premium materials, and experienced professional technicians.

faq.q: Do you build covered decks and patios?
faq.a: Yes, we build both open and covered decks and patios, including roofed structures.

faq.q: Can you repair an existing deck instead of replacing it?
faq.a: Yes, we handle deck repairs as well as full replacements and expansions.

faq.q: What materials do you use for decking?
faq.a: We work with a range of decking materials to fit your budget and maintenance preferences.

faq.q: Do decks require a permit?
faq.a: Most deck projects require a permit, which we handle as part of the process.

services.title: Repairs & Renovations
services.shortDescription: Structural repairs, drywall, siding, and basement or attic conversions.
services.longDescription: We handle structural repairs, drywall repair and installation, siding replacement, wall texturing, and basement or attic conversions to finish out the space you already have.

faq.q: Why choose us for Repairs & Renovations?
faq.a: We provide guaranteed workmanship, premium materials, and experienced professional technicians.

faq.q: Do you handle small repair jobs, or only large projects?
faq.a: We handle both, from single-room repairs to full renovations.

faq.q: Can you convert my basement or attic into living space?
faq.a: Yes, we handle basement and attic conversions as part of our renovation services.

faq.q: Do you match existing wall texture and finishes?
faq.a: Yes, we match existing textures and finishes so repairs blend in seamlessly.

faq.q: How do I know if damage is structural?
faq.a: We'll assess the issue during your free estimate and let you know if structural repair is needed.

services.title: Flooring
services.longDescription: We install hardwood and tile flooring as part of a full remodel or as a standalone project, matched to the style of your home.

faq.q: Why choose us for Flooring?
faq.a: We provide guaranteed workmanship, premium materials, and experienced professional technicians.

faq.q: Do you install flooring as a standalone project?
faq.a: Yes, we install hardwood and tile flooring both as standalone projects and as part of larger remodels.

faq.q: Can you remove and dispose of my old flooring?
faq.a: Yes, removal and disposal of old flooring is included as part of the installation process.

faq.q: What flooring materials do you work with?
faq.a: We install hardwood and tile flooring matched to the style of your home.

faq.q: Can you install flooring that matches the rest of my house?
faq.a: Yes, we can match new flooring to existing floors throughout your home where possible.

Mark goes above and beyond what one would expect. His knowledge and skill in his industry helped us design a more efficient kitchen and office space for our home. He also added a beautiful roof and lighting over our patio.

faqs.q: How much experience does Built Right Construction have?
faqs.a: Built Right Construction was established in 1996. Owner Mark Crawford has more than 20 years of experience in building, design, and construction.

faqs.q: Are you certified to work on older homes?
faqs.a: Yes, Mark Crawford is a Certified EPA Lead-Safe Renovator, qualified to safely work on homes built before 1978.

faqs.q: What types of projects do you handle?
faqs.a: We handle home additions, kitchen and bathroom remodels, decks and patios, structural repairs, and flooring installation.
Call or text us at (615) 500-7487 to schedule your free, no-obligation estimate. We'll walk your property and put together a clear proposal.

faqs.q: Do you handle permits and inspections?
faqs.a: Yes, we handle any required permits and coordinate inspections as part of your project.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during construction?
faqs.a: You don't need to be present for every workday, but we'll coordinate key milestones and walkthroughs with you directly.

faqs.q: What sets Built Right Construction apart?
faqs.a: With over 20 years of experience and Mark Crawford's hands-on involvement in every project, we focus on clear communication, quality craftsmanship, and getting it built right the first time.
